name: aletheia-trading-bot
description: Vollautomatischer Krypto-/Memecoin-Trading-Bot mit Multi-Source-Marktanalyse und Web-Dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
